title: ProbePlanner: an auditable software workflow for MRI-CCF probe trajectory planning in mouse electrophysiology
description: Corrected final-source paper release for ProbePlanner after the preserved v4 failure, post-hoc remediation, and frozen v5 confirmation. Evidence supports software behavior and candidate-pool exactness only; it does not establish subject-specific anatomical accuracy, stereotaxic landmark accuracy, surgical safety, or histological implantation accuracy.
